title_zh: 翻译官的两种工作方式

blocks.body_en: Your computer's processor doesn't understand Python, SQL, or any language humans write. It only understands its own machine instructions. So between your recipe and the kitchen, there is always a translator. There are two styles of translation, and the difference explains a surprising amount of what you see in practice.
blocks.body_zh: 电脑的处理器不认识 Python、SQL 或任何人类写的语言,它只认识自己的机器指令。所以在菜谱和厨房之间,永远隔着一个翻译官。翻译有两种风格,这个区别能解释你日常见到的很多现象。

blocks.anchor_en: A simultaneous interpreter at a meeting: translates sentence by sentence, as the speaker goes. Speech starts immediately; if sentence 40 contains an error, you only find out when the interpreter gets there.
blocks.anchor_zh: 会议上的同声传译:说一句译一句,讲话立刻开始;如果第 40 句有错,要到翻译讲到那里才暴露。
blocks.explain_en: An interpreter reads your source code and executes it line by line, on the spot. Python works this way: `python3 hello.py` starts an interpreter that walks through the file. That's why a Python script can run halfway and then crash on a bug it only just reached.
blocks.explain_zh: 解释器逐行读你的源代码、当场执行。Python 就是这么工作的:`python3 hello.py` 会启动解释器,从头往下走这个文件。这也是为什么一个 Python 脚本可以跑到一半,才在刚碰到的 bug(代码里的错误)上崩掉。

blocks.anchor_en: A book translator: translates the entire book first, checking everything; readers then read the finished translation at full speed. Slow to start, fast to read, and typos are caught before publication.
blocks.anchor_zh: 图书翻译:先把整本书译完、通读校对,读者拿到的是成品,读起来飞快。启动慢,阅读快,错别字在出版前就被抓住。
blocks.explain_en: A compiler translates the whole program into machine code *before* anything runs, producing an executable file. C, Go, and Rust work this way. Many errors are caught at compile time, before the program ever starts — and the compiled result runs faster than interpretation.
blocks.explain_zh: 编译器在运行**之前**就把整个程序翻译成机器码,产出一个可执行文件。C、Go、Rust 是这一类。很多错误在编译阶段、程序还没开始跑时就被抓住——而且编译后的成品跑得比逐行解释快。

blocks.body_en: Where you'll meet this: an agent says "the build failed" (a compile-time error — the translation never finished) versus "it crashed at runtime" (an interpreter or a running program hit a bug mid-execution). Those are different moments, and they call for different fixes. You'll also hear that Python is "slow" — interpretation is a big part of why, and also why it's so pleasant to iterate in.
blocks.body_zh: 你会在哪里遇到它:agent 说 "the build failed"(构建失败)指的是编译期的错误——翻译根本没做完;说 "it crashed at runtime"(运行中崩溃)指的是跑到一半撞上了错误。两者是不同时刻的问题,修法也不同。你还会听到「Python 慢」——逐行解释是主要原因之一,但这也正是它改起来舒服、适合快速试错的原因。

exercises.prompt_en: Python is an interpreted language. What does that mean for a script with a bug on its last line?
exercises.prompt_zh: Python 是解释型语言。这对一个「错误出在最后一行」的脚本意味着什么?
options_en: The script won't start at all
Everything before the last line runs, then it crashes at the end
options_zh: 最后一行之前的部分都会执行,然后在结尾崩掉
这个错误会被自动跳过
exercises.explain_en: Sentence-by-sentence translation: work happens until the bad line is reached. This is why a half-run script may have already changed files or written data — a real operational concern when agents run code for you.
exercises.explain_zh: 说一句译一句:走到出错的那一句之前,活儿都真的干了。所以跑了一半的脚本可能已经改了文件、写了数据——agent 替你跑代码时,这是个真实的风险。

exercises.prompt_en: An agent working on a Go project says: "the build failed, fixing and rebuilding." Which translator style is at work, and when was the error caught?
exercises.prompt_zh: agent 在一个 Go 项目里说:"the build failed, fixing and rebuilding."(构建失败,正在修复并重新构建。)这是哪种翻译风格?错误在什么时候被抓住?
options_en: Compiler — the error was caught before the program ever ran
Interpreter — the error was caught mid-execution
Compiler — the error appeared while the program was running
Neither — builds have nothing to do with translation
options_zh: 编译器——错误在程序运行之前就被抓住了
解释器——错误在执行到一半时被抓住
编译器——错误是在程序运行中出现的
都不是——构建(build)和翻译无关
exercises.explain_en: "Build" is the compile step: whole-book translation. A failed build means the executable was never produced — nothing ran, nothing was touched. Often the *safest* kind of failure.
exercises.explain_zh: "build"(构建)就是编译这一步:整本书式翻译。构建失败 = 成品根本没产出——什么都没运行、什么都没被碰过。往往是**最安全**的一种失败。

exercises.prompt_en: An error that happens while the program is running (as opposed to at compile time) is called a ______ error.
exercises.prompt_zh: 程序运行过程中(而非编译时)发生的错误,英文叫 ______ error。
exercises.explain_en: Runtime — the word for "while it's actually running." You'll meet 'runtime error' constantly in tracebacks and agent explanations.
exercises.explain_zh: Runtime(运行时)——「正在运行的那段时间」。在 traceback(报错追踪信息)和 agent 的解释里,runtime error 都是高频词。

why_en: Why this: when an agent says "build failed" vs "crashed at runtime", those are different moments with different fixes — this lesson is how you tell them apart.
why_zh: 为什么学这个:agent 报「构建失败」(build failed)和「运行中崩溃」(crashed at runtime),是两个不同时刻的问题,修法也不同——这一课让你分得出来。
